content:
The following metrics apply to the bounded blocking buﬀer. Each metric
is preﬁxed by the sub-pipeline name and BlockingBuffer. For example,
sub_pipeline_name.BlockingBuffer.bufferUsage.value.
Metric suﬃx
Description
bufferUsage.value
Percent usage of the buffer_size  based on the
number of records in the buﬀer. buffer_size
represents the maximum number of records written into
the buﬀer as well as in-ﬂight records that have not been
checked.
Relevant statistics: Average
Dimension: PipelineName
